GOVERNMENT OF WEST BENGAL
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT MAGISTRATE
COOCH BEHAR
I FORM B1 ||See rule 25(4)
ORDER
No.fRD-PaE/75 Dated: _/2022
In exercise of the power conferred by sections 14 and 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections Act, 2003
(West Ben. Act XXI of 2003), read with rules 24 and 25 oft he West Bengal Panchayat Election Rules, 2006, I, the
District Panchayat Election Officer and District Magistrate of the District of Cooch Behar, as the prescribed authority
apponted by the State Goverment in the Department of Panchayats and Rural Development under notification No.
623-PN O1 3R-3/2004 dated, Kolkata, the 9th February, 2007 for the purpose of rules 24 & 25 of the said rules, here
by determine after previous publication of the Draft of this order as required under the said rules, for the Grams
specified in column (1) of the Schedule below the number of members to be elected to the Panchayat Samiti
specificd in the corresponding entries in column (2), to divide the area of the Grams into constituencies with serial
numbers assigned to them specified in the corresponding entries in column (3) & (4), constituency or constituencies
Teserved for the Scheduled Castes or the Scheduled Tribes or the Backward classes persons specified in the
comesponding entries in column (5), & constituency or constituencies reserved for women specified in the
coTesponding entries in column (6) of the said schedule.
